text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few months have passed since setting our next goal as the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies. However—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Trai~neeeer~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF is today?!
The bullet train? A flight?!
choice_data_list: Like I told you yesterday, it's still a ways off.
Like I told you yesterday, it's still a ways off, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally~.
It's still so hot out...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! If we just say it's December already
and put on down jackets, can't we play it off?!
choice_data_list: Think I can bluff my way out of this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pien!!
Where did winter go?!
choice_data_list: You must be really looking forward to it, huh?
You must be really looking forward to it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, winter's got the Arima Kinen too, right?
That's the best!!
choice_data_list: I know all about the "Arima Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a GⅠ held at the end of the year.
It is a dream Grand Prix race where the best of the best gather through fan votes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, obvs!
A totally lit, ultra-hype festival!!
I wanna go, I wanna gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I become a super-famous DJ, wonder if they'll invite me?
Guess I better keep spinning those turntables!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At 2,500 meters, it'll be a long-distance race.
Whether that distance will suit Daitaku Helios or not is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Okay.
Now, how about we try running 2,500 meters!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for running with me, Palmer-chin♪
I'm gonna totally tear it up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It's all good, totes fine!
I mean, getting to run longer just hypes you up, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I might actually be pretty cut out for this! ☆
Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios seemed completely at ease, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Whoa!? That's so long!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you done yet?!
Hey, Palmer-chin, are you done yet~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
1,000 meters left!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, no way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, long distances ain't for me!
Arima is impossible!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Wait, isn't it still too early to tell?
choice_data_list: No, I think sprints suit Helios best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not only is sustaining her concentration an issue, but the best way to leverage her speed would surely be the sprint division after all.
choice_data_list: Looks like we'll be sticking with that plan for the Classic year too, huh.
Looks like we'll be sticking with that plan for the Classic year too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You mean you're not going to challenge the royal road races?
No, I think that's totally fine! I do, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
the Kikuka Sho... I mean, aren't those
the most exciting races of all?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you wanna fes, working hard to aim for it might be one way to go... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Mejiro Palmer said,
high-profile races like the Classic Triple Crown
are mostly medium distance or longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In a year where a Triple Crown Umamusume is born,
it practically turns into a full-blown festival, but..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, music fests aren't just about getting invited!
Hosting our own is totally, 100% the move☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna hype myself up, y'know?
I'm confident I can make noise anywhere! Just depends on my mood~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mood... wait,
are you for real?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Helios, you're seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ And so, I thought of something I wanna do!
I wanna co-host a festival with Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: With me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Running with besties is the absolute best!
I wanna be besties 4ever in the biggest races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Mejiro Palmer follows the same path
as Daitaku Helios, that might be possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
To be honest, I haven't decided yet.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just go with the vibe, it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna breeze through on vibes!
...Is what I'd like to say, but.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know the kind of family I come from!
I was just wondering if I ought to stick to the royal road... or something?
choice_data_list: Well, it's the Mejiro family, after all, huh?
I mean, it is the Mejiro family, after all, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious house that has produced countless famed Umamusume.
Carrying that name must come with immense pressure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone expects a lot from the Mejiros.
We really oughta live up to that, huh~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“Must”? Isn't “must”
a word you only use when you're super confident it'll be fun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Having people believe in me means the world, and it makes me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, whenever I fail to meet those expectations,
all sorts of thoughts start running through my head~”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Why not just run away, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Ain't it a total waste to do stuff that just wears ya out??"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Our lives are a sprint, right?
If we don't run on pure fun, it'll be over before we know it!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw Palmer-chin, you're just Palmer-chin, right?
Not just the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You should just do whatever gets you the most hyped, Palmer-chin!
I mean, what else is there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Helios.
That really hit home~! Spoken like a true party person!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~?
And I'll be breakin' away the whole way too☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If that's a race,
then it's nothing short of the abso-freakin'-lute best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And you know, maybe one day we could co-host a festival!
Wouldn't that be great~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will the day come when Daitaku Helios and
Mejiro Palmer's paths cross...?
I had one more thing to look forward to in the future.
